_comment: Rubber City Jazz & Blues Festival 2026 lineup, transcribed from the schedule poster on 2026-08-27. 17 poster sets plus the pre-existing Ticketmaster Lock 3 show (tagged, never upserted) per the ADR at docs/festival-playbook.md's pointer for rubber-city-jazz-2026. Consumed by scripts/import-festival.js.
_schema: Every start and end is an EASTERN wall clock ('h:mm AM/PM') read against the enclosing day's 'date'. A set that starts after Eastern midnight therefore belongs on the NEXT day's entry, under its own true Eastern date, NOT at the tail of the previous night's list: the importer binds both ends of a set to its day's date and orders each venue-day bucket by wall clock, so a 12:30 AM set filed on the previous day would start 24 hours early and inherit an end time from the 11 PM set. buildPlan refuses any derived span that is non-positive or longer than 6 hours, which is what that mistake looks like. Festival-specific copy lives in this file, never in the importer: 'city' and 'presentedBy' build the 'Part of the X, <range> in <city>, presented by <presenter>.' sentence (each clause is dropped when its key is absent) and 'extraTags' are the genre tags every set carries.

festival.logistics: Three days of jazz and blues across five downtown Akron venues: BLU Jazz+, the Akron Summit Library Main Branch, the Mustill Store / Water Wheel site at Cascade Locks Park, the Akron Art Museum, and Lock 3. Full schedule and set times at rubbercityjazz.org.
